# Polytoria

Source: https://github.com/polytoria/polytoria-game/blob/main/README.md

<img src="docs/header.svg" width="100%">

# Polytoria


Polytoria is a 3D multiplayer gaming platform built on top of the [Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/). It provides a set of tools for creating your multiplayer games, with server-client architecture, synchronized state replication and scripting powered by [Luau](https://luau.org/). Worlds can be published to [polytoria.com](http://polytoria.com/), which is accessible from Windows, macOS and Linux, with mobile in the works!

![15 Seconds by phoe](docs/creator.png)

*Photo credit: [15 Seconds by phoe](https://polytoria.com/places/12661)*

## Getting the Software

You can head to [polytoria.com](https://polytoria.com/) to register your account. The download button will be available in the [worlds](https://polytoria.com/places) page.

To launch the creator software, head to [polytoria.com/create](https://polytoria.com/create/) and click "Launch Creator".

## Contributing

Contributing guides are currently a work in progress.

Meanwhile, you can join the [Polytoria Contributors](https://discord.gg/HUgEE9FhSU) Discord server if you have any questions!

# Contributing to Polytoria

Source: https://github.com/polytoria/polytoria-game/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

# Contributing to Polytoria

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Polytoria! We welcome contributions from the community to help improve our platform.

The full contributor guide can be found in our Documentation:

- Getting started: [https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/](https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/)
- Software setup: [https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/prerequisites/](https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/prerequisites/)
- PR guidelines: [https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/contributor/pull-requests/](https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/contributor/pull-requests/)
- DCO requirements: [https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/contributor/dco/](https://v2docs.polytoria.com/contributing/software/contributor/dco/)

## Quick checklist

Before opening a PR, make sure to:

- Search for an existing issue or discussion
- Keep the PR focused on a single change
- Sign off your commits with DCO
- Format the code (`dotnet format`)
- Build and test your changes locally

For setup help and early contributor discussion, you can join the Contributors Discord server: [https://discord.gg/HUgEE9FhSU](https://discord.gg/HUgEE9FhSU)
